sources_considered.why: Full report gives OpenAI’s revenue and operating loss and states that the Financial Times reviewed the financial statements.
Independent Reuters reporting provides the Anthropic comparison inputs.

evidence_items.locator: Financial-results discussion, including revenue and loss-from-operations paragraphs
evidence_items.explanation: Ars reports OpenAI revenue of $13.07 billion and operating loss of $20.92 billion, implying approximately $34 billion in operating costs. Combined with the Reuters inputs in e2, the resulting comparison supports the narrowly defined ranking.

metric_scope.metric: Comparative annual operating expenses per revenue dollar

inputs: Ars Technica: OpenAI 2025 revenue USD 13.07 billion.
Ars Technica: OpenAI 2025 operating loss USD 20.92 billion.
e2, Reuters: Anthropic 2025 operating expenses USD 12.65 billion and revenue approximately USD 4.6 billion.
derived.formula: OpenAI expenses = 13.07 + 20.92 = 33.99 billion, approximately 34 billion; OpenAI ratio = 33.99 / 13.07 = 2.6006; Anthropic ratio = 12.65 / 4.6 = 2.75.
derived.rounding: Ratios rounded to cents: OpenAI 2.60; Anthropic 2.75. Computed costs inherit rounding in the reported inputs.

evidence_items.locator: Opening financial discussion; revenue paragraph and paragraph beginning “The AI lab spent”
evidence_items.explanation: Supplies the Anthropic component of the derived comparison in e1. It does not independently measure OpenAI or establish the complete ranking.
